rationale: The student focuses on individual large digits (9s) rather than comparing place values starting from the highest place (thousands). A place-value comparison demonstrating comparison starting at the thousands place directly targets this misconception.
intent: Demonstrate compare on the place-value with values [2998,3002]. Tutor points at: the thousands place column

frames.caption: Line up 2,998 and 3,002 by place. Start with the biggest place.
3 thousands is more than 2 thousands, so 3,002 is greater than 2,998. The smaller places cannot catch up, even if they are 9s.

judgement.reasoning: The student believes 3,999 > 4,001 because it has nines. This worked demo explicitly targets that exact misconception using a near-identical parallel example (2,998 vs 3,002), directly showing that comparing the largest place first means 3 thousands beats 2 thousands and noting explicitly that smaller nines cannot catch up.
judgement.verdict: Yes, this demo directly addresses the student's exact misconception with a clean parallel example showing why the largest place decides the comparison regardless of nines.
